connectorUiConfig.title: Claroty xDome (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The Claroty xDome connector polls the Claroty xDome public API directly from Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) - no agent, collector VM, or syslog forwarder required. Connect once with your xDome API root URL and a Bearer API token, and the following data types stream into dedicated tables: **Alerts**, **Device-Alert relations**, **OT Activity Events**, **Vulnerabilities**, **Device-Vulnerability relations**, **Device inventory**, and **Audit Log**. Each data type supports an optional filter so you can cut down ingested volume.

sampleQueries.query:
ClarotyXDomeDeviceAlert_CL
| summarize AffectedDevices = dcount(DeviceUid) by AlertId, AlertName
| sort by AffectedDevices desc

ClarotyXDomeVulnerability_CL
| where IsKnownExploited == true
| sort by CvssV3Score desc

ClarotyXDomeAuditLog_CL
| where Action == 'User Logged In'
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

customs.name: Claroty xDome API token
customs.description: A Claroty xDome public API token (Bearer) with read access is required. Generate it in the xDome console under Admin Settings > User Management.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Prerequisites
instructionSteps.description: Ensure you have the required access and configuration before connecting.

parameters.content:
## Prerequisites

- A Claroty xDome tenant with the public API enabled.
- An xDome API token (Bearer) with read access. Generate it in the xDome console under **Admin Settings > User Management**.
- Your xDome API root URL, for example `https://<region>.api.claroty.com`. The connector appends the `/api/v1/...` paths automatically - do not include a trailing slash or the `/api/v1` segment.
- Outbound network connectivity from the Microsoft Sentinel CCF service to your xDome API endpoint. If your xDome API restricts source IPs, allowlist the Microsoft Sentinel **Scuba** service tag.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Connect to Claroty xDome
instructionSteps.description: Add a connection with your xDome API root URL and Bearer token, then choose which data types to ingest (all are selected by default). Optionally provide a per-data-type filter and polling window.

parameters.content:
## Optional per-data-type filters

Leave a filter blank to ingest everything for that data type. To cut volume, paste a single xDome **filter_by** JSON object; it is combined (AND) with the incremental time window. Examples:

- **Alerts** - only some categories: `{"field":"category","operation":"in","value":["Threat","Segmentation"]}`
- **OT Events** - exclude scans: `{"field":"event_type","operation":"not_in","value":["Scan"]}`
- **Vulnerabilities** - high severity only: `{"field":"cvss_v3_score","operation":"greater_or_equal","value":7}`
- **Devices** - OT/Medical only: `{"field":"device_category","operation":"in","value":["OT","Medical"]}`
- **Audit Log** - authentication only: `{"field":"category","operation":"in","value":["Authentication"]}`
